description: Universal Micro Tool Kit. Fits 1 1/4 inches friction-fit wands. This is a highly effective and versatile micro cleaning kit that will help you effortlessly clean all delicate appliances and difficult to reach places in your day to day, including your TV, computer, printer, car, home workshop bench plus many more. Kit contains: one adaptor, Pipe connector with adjustable suction fitting, Flexible tube (approx. 36” length, Curved 'elbow' extension pipe. Straight extension pipe, wide oval brush, Narrow round brush, thin (chamfered) crevice tool. PLEASE NOTE: One of the adapters has an airflow control valve that looks like small holes in the tool. This is not a defect but intentional design. It cannot be fully closed for two reasons. It was intentionally designed and manufactured this way to avoid too much suction on delicate electronics and jewelry items. IT HELPS TO AVOID VACUUM CLEANER OVERHEATING WHICH MAY LEAD TO MALFUNCTION. Fits all vacuums that accept standard 1 1/4 inch; inside diameter attachments35 mm (1 1/4 inch) adapter included for European sized friction-fit wands. Does not fit any clip-mounted wands like Dyson and Shark. Does not fit any hand held vacuum that does not have a hose or wand. Does not fit shark vacuums.
